audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text was generic and misgendered Mel throughout ('his combo', 'his tower', 'his engage'). Mel is female per champ-gender.js.
audit.why: Mel out-ranges Cassiopeia early (Radiant Volley 950 vs Noxious Blast 850) so the first levels are hers, but Cassiopeia's sustained poison out-scales a shield tuned against burst. Difficulty 5.5/10 matches the 52.93% win rate over 427 games.
audit.corrected: Early lane belongs to Mel on range; from level 3 Cassiopeia's Q-into-Twin-Fang pattern takes it back, and every commit is gated on Rebuttal (38/35/33/29/26s).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side read Skill on six of seven rows while content win[] read Mel, Skill, Cassiopeia x5 — the two layers rendered different answers to 'who wins this level'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart and the content layer agree (Mel level 1, Skill level 2, Cassiopeia from level 3), and the whys[] already describe exactly that progression. The full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side Mel, [1] Skill, [2..6] Cassiopeia, with each why rewritten to match the new verdict. No win[N] edit is needed because the content layer was already correct on every row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was stated only as 'reflects your projectiles back' with no cooldown, and Miasma advice was written for an enemy with a dash. Mel has no dash in her kit.
audit.why: Twin Fang (E) carries the projectile flag and is Cassiopeia's entire damage output, so Rebuttal reflecting it is matchup-defining — and it is a 38s cooldown at rank 1, 26s at rank 5, the longest window in the lane. Miasma's grounding has no dash to shut off against Mel; its value here is the slow zone on a 24s cooldown at rank 1. Searing Brilliance (P) executes off Overwhelm stacks and Golden Eclipse (R) hits at 25000 range, so Mel can finish you from off-screen.
audit.corrected: Poke only on Rebuttal's downtime; use Miasma as a slow zone under her Solar Snare step-up rather than as an anti-dash tool; track your HP against the Overwhelm execute rather than the health bar.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that exists to hold real numbers.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal 38/35/33/29/26s, Solar Snare 11s at rank 1, Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted under an R-stun title and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted under a half-HP title (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2).
audit.why: The title promised one thing and the body explained another.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now explains the facing requirement on Petrifying Gaze; dontsFull[2].d now explains the Searing Brilliance execute threshold.

notes: Level chart: full-layer phases[].side disagreed with content win[] on five of seven rows; packet.levelChart and win[] agreed with each other and with the whys[], so the full layer was moved to match. No win[N] edits were needed — the content layer was already correct on every row. Mel's W (Rebuttal) carries a derived 'terrain' flag and _missing suggests she can cut your retreat with it; Riot's own description says only that it is a barrier around herself that reflects, blocks damage and grants move speed, so I did not write any wall/retreat-cutting claim — per the brief, trust the description over the flag. Build advice is internally inconsistent on this page and I left it alone: content spikes[2]/late recommend Rylai's and Void Staff while full report[8] recommends Seraph's into Liandry's into Rabadon's. Someone should pick one line.
